description: Source code for wave analyzer functionality, including initialization, event handling, and data retrieval related to engine signal analysis in firmware context.

classes.name: WaveReader
classes.description: Represents a wave input channel, maintains state and event counters for a specific input pin.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the WaveReader's hardware is initialized and started.

methods.name: waAnaWidthCallback
methods.description: Callback for width events, updates signal timing information.

methods.name: WaveReader::onFallEvent
methods.description: Handles fall events, updates timing metrics and engine cycle counters.

methods.name: waIcuPeriodCallback
methods.description: Callback for period measurement, calls onFallEvent.

methods.name: setWaveModeSilent
methods.description: Sets the input driver mode for specified wave input.

methods.name: initWave
methods.description: Initializes a wave input with specified name and index.

methods.name: WaveReader
methods.description: Constructor, initializes member variables for a wave reader instance.

methods.name: waTriggerEventListener
methods.description: Handles trigger events, calculates engine cycle duration.

methods.name: waThread
methods.description: Thread function for periodic wave chart publishing.

methods.name: getWaveLowWidth
methods.description: Returns the last measured low width (duration) of the wave signal.

methods.name: getSignalOnTime
methods.description: Computes the on-time of the signal in milliseconds based on last high width.

methods.name: getWaveOffset
methods.description: Returns time offset between engine cycle events.

methods.name: getSignalPeriodMs
methods.description: Returns the period of the wave signal in milliseconds.

methods.name: reportWave
methods.description: Logs detailed wave data for specified input index.
